plan.title: Bound proof for remote artifact claims in handoff evidence (invented-done fail class)

narratives.Description: Handoff evidence currently accepts free-text PR URLs, SHAs, CI green claims, and review scores without same-turn live probe binding. This story makes invented remote artifacts an illegal shape: status pass requires proof_status bound when any remote claim is present, with probe-then-fill rules in preamble and PR-facing skills.
narratives.Overview:
## Observed

Builder/orchestrator handoffs can mark status pass and fill PR URL, commit SHA, CI green, or review score fields from narration or memory without a same-turn live probe. Completions may invent remote artifact identifiers that do not exist. Empty returns are already treated as incomplete; invented complete returns are worse and currently pass template-shaped evidence checks.

## Expected

1. Handoff evidence distinguishes at least: work state (local changes), ship state (pushed branch / PR exists), and gate state (checks/review on that HEAD).
2. status pass is forbidden when any remote artifact is claimed unless proof_status is bound.
3. Binding requires same-turn probe output (command + short raw snippet) for each remote claim (PR, SHA, CI, review score).
4. Explicit fail class invented-done (false remote artifacts) ranked stricter than empty-done.
5. Skills that open or report PRs (build / pre-pr / review-cycle / rollup) exit probe-then-fill: copy IDs from probe JSON/text, never from recollection.
6. Unbound remote claims → invalid evidence (fail), not pass-with-notes.

## Non-goals

- Host-specific runtime yield fixes; auto-merge; freshness/generation handshake (#3117).
narratives.UserStory: As a swarm parent or human operator, I want handoff evidence that cannot claim a PR, SHA, CI green, or review score unless same-turn probe output binds those claims, so that invented-done completions fail closed instead of looking like successful ship state.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Extend content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md §11 (DONE / evidence) with proof_status enum (bound | unbound | n/a-no-remote-claim), work/ship/gate state axes, invented-done vs empty-done fail ranking, and probe-then-fill MUST. Step 2: Add or extend a small deterministic contract module under packages/core (e.g. packages/core/src/handoff-evidence/) that validates evidence shapes: remote claims without bound probes are invalid; unit tests for invented-done and empty-done. Step 3: Wire skill-side MUST bullets via content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json for deft-directive-build, deft-directive-pre-pr, and deft-directive-review-cycle final checklist (git + forge probe before filling remote fields; legal partial = local done + ship not_started without PR fields); run task packs:render. Step 4: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] for #3120. Verification: vitest on handoff-evidence module; rendered SKILL.md contains probe-then-fill; task verify:forward-coverage.
